note: Board and go (brief 018 §5), the twin of route-a-pressure: the same route to the ambush (Pressure for Help, the square's mast looped across it, no Reroute); then the Enforcer holds Vale 19.5 m out while the three fire, walks him in once the box is gone (car.unboxed: the crew broken and its car gone, brief 096) (Motive briefs/067/motive-square.md §7), boards, the three board after him, and the car leaves with the whole cell. Pressure brings no warning from Inez, so the five fire at once. The three lock rival-2 then rival-1 as the ambush springs (focus fire, as route G). Brief 101 (engine 0.52.0, the square's mast on the terrace's west lamp, Sky's pick B; Motive briefs/101/motive/mast-pressure.md §1): the Pressure card shows the mast would tape it at her post (+1 T, Alert 1 at the desk's next scan + 3 s, the dial's robots to her, the Fixer's face on file). A player reading it loops the mast first: the loop is the same +1 T and buys silence (no Alert, no robots, no face, and no log of the Fixer beside the turned Inez, so her job stays unexposed); its price is time. So the Tech loops the mast from the cabinet (live about 0:45 to 2:45), the Scout watches Inez from her start and listens beside her inside the loop, the Fixer walks in from her wait behind the mast for the Pressure and back out before the loop runs out, the call goes when the rival car is seen coming, and the entrance loop follows the mast's (one at a time: live about 3:05 to 5:05), so the Enter starts about 3:05, inside the pressed guard's window (Motive: a call at 2:35 keeps him away to about 4:14).
